title: Autonomous-System-Wide Unique BGP Identifier for BGP-4
summary: This standards-track document relaxes the BGP Identifier definition to a 4-octet unsigned non-zero integer and requires uniqueness only within an autonomous system. It does not change other BGP behavior.

eli5.summary: Each router in a network needs a name tag only unique inside its own team. This relaxes the old rule that it must be unique worldwide.
